vision.name: Namekian Flinch
vision.text:
(If this card is Rejuvenated, search your discard pile for an Ally and place it into play.)
[Defense] Stops a physical attack.
You may shuffle a Dragon Ball in play into its owner's Life Deck. If your MP is level 3 or higher, search your Life Deck for a Dragon Ball and place it into play.
(Most Recent Printing)
vision.note: S07 reprint of S01_BST_86; text compared on the sheet; wording differs, transcribed from this card
